notes: DWM now speaks the CAN service's AIDL properly. The v0.18 probe got the interface name; the APK export got the answer, because com.tw.carinfoservice ships its own .aidl source files inside the APK - CarServiceAidl (64 methods) and CarServiceCallBack (66), fully commented. Both are now in the project byte-for-byte and the build generates the stubs, so the transaction numbering cannot disagree with the service. DWM binds the service, registers a callback and reads live vehicle data: real GEAR (D/N/R/P/S), reverse, road speed, engine rpm, handbrake, headlights, turn signal, doors and boot, seatbelts, voltage, coolant and ambient temp, fuel, steering trace, the 16 parking radar sensors, and TPMS - pressure, temperature and warning state per wheel. Reverse now comes from the gear itself rather than inferring it from the deck ducking its audio; the DO_MUTE broadcast stays as a fallback since it needs no bind. Two findings worth knowing: getCarReverse() is a dead stub on this ROM - its case returns a hardcoded -1 and never reads CAN, so reverse must be received pushed, not polled. And extendedInterface() is not a getter: it writes bytes to the vehicle bus. DWM never calls it. New report section 0b shows every signal with 'never reported' for the ones this car does not put on the bus.
